mentions.name: Million Short
mentions.description: A long-tail search engine that lets users exclude up to the top 1 million most popular websites from search results, currently undergoing a major overhaul that adds a sizable independent index and new features.
mentions.problem: Popular websites dominate search results, making lesser-known long-tail sites hard to discover.
mentions.source_excerpt: MillionShort - A long tail search engine that lets you remove up to the top 1 million most popular websites from results - https://millionshort.com
mentions.author: taxonomyman
